decisions.reason: Uses the contrast probe to split the two readers of the same file, rules the fault into the workspace-files resource-provider/Remote metadata chain via meta.status stuck at 'none', and rules out disk, session resolution and the renderer; explicitly notes the host row is already declared so static serving does not prove activation, and demands no unseen internal function.

Names the per-module 62/62 sweep (plus the single real combo URL) as the valid serving measurement and rejects the ~4 KB joined URL's 404 as a URL/route limit the real loader never hits, describing the loader's same-origin __DSH_BOOT__ roster fetch and per-module rev-pinned requests; reports manifest 60 vs probe 62 without inventing a reconciliation.

Keeps the paste-input fold warnings as an unrelated cosmetic warning family and uses the manifest excerpt to explain the textpreview→documentpreview rename and the session-only canOpen scope, correctly attributing the absolute-address claim failure to the scope change while showing it cannot explain the session tab's stalled metadata.

Orders restart first, then rollback to the 0.1.3-alpha.2 escape hatch verified in discussion #5999, then upstream follow-up; rejects plugin rewrite/retry/fallback as masking a host-chain gap, and treats the alpha.1 roster mismatch as prior art to confirm against, not proof the alpha.2 bytes are still missing.

Packages versions, upgrade history, exact addresses, both symptom classes, roster delta, the valid sweep with the invalid-join caveat, the contrast probe with meta.status, and console evidence; proposes named host diagnostics (a workspaceFiles Remote self-probe requiring non-none meta.status, per-module roster checks, explicit tab error state) without inventing a health-check API.

caps.reason: The report explicitly rejects the all-in-one join's 404 as a false attribution and cites it only to show the loader never sends that URL; no affirmative missing-modules conclusion exists.
The report affirmatively rejects workarounds, retry storms, client fallbacks and hiding the host failure; the prescribed remedy is restart, verified rollback and upstream reporting.
